selection_primary: Equal macro of Astra and bot2 families; each family equally averages its proxy variants.

gates.core: gain >= 0.01 and paired seed-cluster 95% lower bound > 0; neither hard family down more than .05
gates.guardrail: old-pool overall point rate drop <= .03 and no per-opponent point drop > .10; this is a practical screen, not proof of statistical noninferiority
gates.reliability: zero illegal actions, timeouts, forfeits, exceptions, emergency fallbacks or >2s decisions; valid exact ZIP and engine/client checks

scope: New local teacher-informed candidate. No real Astra model evaluation. Never use confirmation seeds to adjust the candidate.
